digest.component_or_area: ticket summary and identifier resolution surface
propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state but omits the resolved alias field from its return payload, causing agents to default to locally salient four-character prefixes instead of durable aliases
The summary JSON schema, library, MCP, and CLI contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape, making short prefixes the most available identifier in agent workflows
Agents require affirmative guidance to prefer aliases in tracker commands after discovery while reserving canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts like rebar-ticket trailers

Pinned behavioral evaluation confirmed that adding the resolved alias field to summary output independently produces 25/25 alias-based commands, and adding adjacent affirmative guidance independently produces 25/25 aliases
